description: Create, update or destroy a reverse_proxy auth_profile entry in SOPHOS UTM.

parameters.name: aaa
parameters.description: List of references to utm_aaa objects (allowed users or groups).

parameters.name: backend_mode
parameters.description: Specifies if the backend server needs authentication ([Basic|None]). Choices: "Basic" "None" ← (default)

parameters.name: backend_strip_basic_auth
parameters.description: Should the login data be stripped when proxying the request to the backend host. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: backend_user_prefix
parameters.description: Prefix string to prepend to the username for backend authentication. Default: ""

parameters.name: backend_user_suffix
parameters.description: Suffix string to append to the username for backend authentication. Default: ""

parameters.name: basic_prompt
parameters.description: The message in the basic authentication prompt.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Optional comment string. Default: ""

parameters.name: frontend_cookie
parameters.description: Frontend cookie name.

parameters.name: frontend_cookie_secret
parameters.description: Frontend cookie secret.

parameters.name: frontend_form
parameters.description: Frontend authentication form name.

parameters.name: frontend_form_template
parameters.description: Frontend authentication form template. Default: ""

parameters.name: frontend_login
parameters.description: Frontend login name.

parameters.name: frontend_logout
parameters.description: Frontend logout name.

parameters.name: frontend_mode
parameters.description: Frontend authentication mode (Form|Basic). Choices: "Basic" ← (default) "Form"

parameters.name: frontend_realm
parameters.description: Frontend authentication realm.

parameters.name: frontend_session_allow_persistency
parameters.description: Allow session persistency. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: frontend_session_lifetime
parameters.description: Session lifetime.

parameters.name: frontend_session_lifetime_limited
parameters.description: Specifies if limitation of session lifetime is active. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: frontend_session_lifetime_scope
parameters.description: Scope for frontend_session_lifetime (days|hours|minutes). Choices: "days" "hours" ← (default) "minutes"

parameters.name: frontend_session_timeout
parameters.description: Session timeout.

parameters.name: frontend_session_timeout_enabled
parameters.description: Specifies if session timeout is active. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: frontend_session_timeout_scope
parameters.description: Scope for frontend_session_timeout (days|hours|minutes). Choices: "days" "hours" "minutes" ← (default)

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules. Default: {}

parameters.name: logout_delegation_urls
parameters.description: List of logout URLs that logouts are delegated to. Default: []

parameters.name: logout_mode
parameters.description: Mode of logout (None|Delegation). Choices: "None" ← (default) "Delegation"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

parameters.name: redirect_to_requested_url
parameters.description: Should a redirect to the requested URL be made. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of the object. present creates or updates an object. absent deletes an object if present. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_host
parameters.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: utm_port
parameters.description: The port of the REST interface. Default: 4444

parameters.name: utm_protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_token
parameters.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en, Chapter 2.4.2.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether the REST interface’s SSL certificate should be verified or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create UTM proxy_auth_profile
  community.general.utm_proxy_auth_profile:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestAuthProfileEntry
    aaa: [REF_OBJECT_STRING, REF_ANOTHEROBJECT_STRING]
    basic_prompt: "Authentication required: Please login"
    frontend_session_lifetime: 1
    frontend_session_timeout: 1
    state: present

- name: Remove UTM proxy_auth_profile
  community.general.utm_proxy_auth_profile:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestAuthProfileEntry
    state: absent

- name: Read UTM proxy_auth_profile
  community.general.utm_proxy_auth_profile:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestAuthProfileEntry
    state: info
